string.text: The military complex at Agroprom is active again. Clear its present garrison and recover the latest command archive. Both objectives are mandatory.
Clear the Agroprom military base and recover the command archive.
The garrison is gone and the archive is ours. Good work.
The Dark Valley bandits keep a ledger of tolls, couriers and buyers at their base. Break their defense and recover the complete record.
Assault the Dark Valley bandit base and seize its ledger.
Their private business is private no longer.
Freedom keeps reserve callsigns and frequencies at its Army Warehouses base. Clear the defenders and take the signal book from command.
Clear Freedom's main base and capture its frequency book.
They will have to rebuild their communications network.
The mercenary headquarters in Dead City holds copies of active contracts, clients and routes. Clear the base and remove that archive.
Assault the Dead City mercenary base and recover its contracts.
This intelligence is worth far more than the paper carrying it.
